top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 2
top_news.summary: Oil advanced for a third session on heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz after an escalation of hostilities between the US and Iran.

top_news.title: Seraphim Launches New ETF to Target Pure-Play Space Investors
top_news.summary: Investors are being offered a new way to bet on space via a fund that focuses exclusively on a sector thrust into the limelight by the IPO of Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

top_news.title: Ambani’s Streaming Site Eyes Millions of Indian Diaspora
top_news.summary: India’s largest video streaming platform JioHotstar is expanding overseas for the first time, launching in the UK, Canada and Singapore as it seeks to tap millions of potential viewers in the growing South Asian diaspora.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set for Declines as Oil Extends Gains: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were set to decline Wednesday as surging oil prices pushed bond yields higher and stoked fears that resurgent inflation will force central banks to tighten monetary policy.

top_news.title: Using Smart Devices to Improve Sleep
top_news.summary: A National Sleep Foundation poll found nearly 4 in 10 U.S. adults, or 37%, are dissatisfied with their sleep, and 60% aren't getting enough of it. Hatch is launching a Hatch Sleep Clock, a contactless sleep tracker built to change sleep behavior. CEO Ann Crady Weiss joins Buisnessweek Daily to discuss the launch and how she hopes the smart device will help users. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bessent’s Bond Gains Wiped Out as Treasury Yields Jump Again
top_news.summary: The yields on the longest-dated US government bonds shot back to levels seen just before Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent shocked markets last month by expanding a buyback program in an effort to halt the rise.

top_news.title: Republicans Seek More Changes at Hobbled Consumer Watchdog
top_news.summary: A group of House Republicans unveiled a proposal that aims to overhaul the structure of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which has been entangled in legal fights as the Trump administration moves to cut the agency’s funding and staffing.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 1
top_news.summary: US oil prices topped $90 a barrel and European gas prices surged to a three year high, as fresh American strikes on Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Oil Jumps on US-Iran Jitters: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A surge in oil prices rippled through global markets, hitting stocks and bonds on worries that higher energy costs will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to boost rates.

top_news.title: New Leaks Draw Brazil Top Court Judge Deeper Into Banco Master Scandal
top_news.summary: A prominent Brazilian Supreme Court judge is facing renewed scrutiny over alleged ties to Banco Master SA after the release of text messages from the former owner of the failed lender.
